# The archived project's own identifier families, copied verbatim out of
# archive/ so that tests/test_plain_name_check.py can plant real codes rather
# than invented ones. Read out on 2026-09-09 with
#
#     grep -rhoE '\b[A-Z]{1,4}-[0-9]{1,4}\b' archive/ | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
#
# One token per line, most frequent first, with the count that grep reported.
# The first line is the one a test plants when it needs a single code.
#
# They live here, and not as literals in the test, because tests/fixtures/ is
# text quoted verbatim from somewhere else -- which is exactly what these are,
# and which is why the plain-name check does not read this directory. A check
# that reported its own test's vocabulary on every write is a check somebody
# turns off in a week.
